summary: Session Feedback feature verified end-to-end. 12/12 backend pytest cases pass; frontend widget on NotesPage and admin panel Session Feedback tab both render and behave correctly. 0035_session_feedback.sql is confirmed NOT applied in Supabase; the graceful admin fallback (table_ready:false) works, and POST/PATCH surface PGRST205 as HTTP 404 (via Supabase REST) — the widget correctly displays the error text in data-testid=session-feedback-error.

minor.issue: When table is missing, endpoint returns 404 (from Supabase PGRST205) instead of the 500 the review-request hinted at. Not a bug — pass-through — but consider mapping to 503 with a friendlier message once the migration is applied.
Same 404 pass-through when table is missing. Also — endpoint silently returns {ok:true} even when the row does not exist (no 404 like DELETE does). Minor consistency gap.

action_items: Apply /app/scripts/migrations/0035_session_feedback.sql in Supabase Studio → SQL Editor so that POST persist and admin list start returning real data.

(Optional) Wrap POST /api/sessions/{id}/feedback in a try/except that maps PGRST205 to HTTP 503 + a friendlier message, matching the admin GET graceful fallback, so students don't see raw Postgres JSON in the error toast pre-migration.
(Optional) PATCH /api/admin/session-feedback/{id}/resolve — return 404 when no row is updated (parity with DELETE).
critical_code_review_comments: wave_endpoints.py L438-441: message length validation runs AFTER category check but before rate-limit lookup — fine, but if `body` is not a dict FastAPI throws before reaching handler; body typed as `dict` (not Pydantic model) means schema errors surface as generic 422s. Consider a Pydantic model for a cleaner 400/422 contract.

SessionFeedbackWidget.jsx L119: the error span renders raw `e.message` which today is Supabase's PGRST205 JSON dump. Once migration is applied the message will still surface as-is; recommend parsing and showing a friendly line to end-users.
AdminPanel.jsx SessionFeedbackTab (L1734+): file is now 1886 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting SessionFeedbackTab into its own file under /components/admin/.

seed_data_creation: None. Test used a synthetic session_id (00000000-...-0abc) for validation-only assertions; no rows written since table is missing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After migration 0035 is applied, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_session_feedback.py — the two `assert status_code in (200, 404, 500)` tests will pass on 200 and the response body assertions in test_valid_submit_reaches_persist will assert ok:true. Also worth verifying: (a) submitted feedback shows up in /api/admin/session-feedback with table_ready:true, (b) resolve toggles resolved=true and resolved_at is set, (c) DELETE removes the row and returns 200 (then 404 on repeat).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as designed. The PGRST205 (table missing) path is intentionally handled gracefully in admin GET; the POST/PATCH mutation paths intentionally surface the error to prompt migration. Ship criterion (widget renders + admin tab renders + endpoints enforce auth + validation is correct + error path fires) all met.
